name: Morlos'Aran
summary: In southern Felwood, Morlos'Aran lies in ruins beneath demonic blight. The ancient night elf settlement flourished before the Great Sundering.

sections.title: Echoes of the Golden Age
sections.body: Before the Sundering, Morlos'Aran was a grand center of ancient kaldorei life. Like Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and Ordil'Aran across northern Kalimdor, its marble arches and moonlit plazas held elven life and arcana. The Well of Eternity collapsed, and the city broke apart. Its shattered colonnades remain from the height of kaldorei civilization.

sections.title: A Blighted Relic
sections.body: During the Third War, the Burning Legion trampled the corridor where Morlos'Aran stood. Demonic corruption and toxic mire choked its surviving foundations. The ruins suffered a grimmer fate than those in Darkshore and Ashenvale, where decay and wilderness took hold. Today, wandering beasts, corrupted elementals, and remnants of shadow forces haunt the ruins and linger in Felwood.

faq.answer: Morlos'Aran was a major night elf settlement that thrived before the Great Sundering. Along with sister cities across ancient Kalimdor, it belonged to the heart of kaldorei civilization before falling into ruin ten thousand years ago.

faq.q: Why does the name end in ''Aran'?
faq.answer: The meaning of the suffix isn't recorded. It appears in several pre-Sundering night elf cities, including Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran in Darkshore, Ordil'Aran in Ashenvale, and Tethris'Aran in Desolace.
Morlos'Aran lies in southern Felwood, near the border crossing from Ashenvale. Its crumbling marble architecture can be seen among the corrupted, withered trees just off the main path.

faq.q: What threats wander these ruins today?
faq.answer: Corrupted wildlife, tainted treants, and lingering demonic spawn infest the forest around Morlos'Aran. They make the ruins extremely hazardous for travelers heading north into Felwood.

angles.text: As a night elf, Morlos'Aran offers a tragic reminder of how far the empire fell. Sacred ancestral stonework now lies swallowed by the Legion's foul demonic corruption.
As a druid, you can see the damage to Felwood in the twisted earth around Morlos'Aran's foundations. The ruin spurs Cenarion efforts to purify the land.
